push.title: D 4-4 vs YSLincorporated | You: 9.7 (5th best match performance of the season)
push.body:
Well I'll be. PhogsToffees, a 9.7. You played like the main character tonight.

THE GOOD
+ 2 of 2 shots on target. Smart shooting is half of finishing.
+ 5 key passes (up from your usual 2). Selfless as a church potluck, and twice as filling.
+ Man of the Match, your 12th for us. Player of the match. The trophy suits you.
+ Passes attempted 43, up from your usual 26. You earned that one the honest way.
+ Your passes to BellyTb1 had perfect weight and perfect timing.

THE BAD
- Misplaced passes 10, up from your usual 6. Here's how: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
- 3rd straight match under 25% tackle success. That's the part of the tape we'll rewind.
- Shots: 2. Nice base. Build to 3+.

Quick drill: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.

PhogsToffees, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: If you're gonna make a mistake, make it at full speed and learn it at half.

You're the real deal. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
BellyTb1, if I could bottle that 9.4, I'd sell it at every gas station from here to Wichita.

THE GOOD
+ 6 shots at YSLincorporated's goal. You kept testing them until something cracked.
+ 2 key passes. Making your teammates look good is the most generous thing in football.
+ Match rating 9.4, up from your usual 7.8. More of that, please and thank you.
+ You and PhogsToffees linked up like peanut butter and jelly. Keep making sandwiches.
+ 20 completed passes nudged it up +0.1. Every inch.

THE BAD
- Tackles won 0, down from your usual 1. Let's turn that around by next session.
- Pass accuracy: 80%. Let's make 88%+ the habit.
- Goals per shot on target: 50%. Don't settle; 60%+ is there for the taking.

Practice plan: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.

Last thing, BellyTb1. You're not behind; you're just early to your comeback.

You make coaching fun. - Coach Lasso
